record.limits_note: Per-ip-shaping: upload speed throttled above 5 TB, described by HN as a 'harsh inflection' around 16 TB. Quotas are quoted in decimal TB, not TiB. Rclone about reports 9.095 TiB for a 10 TB plan (forum.rclone.org/t/45928), so the real capacity is ~9% smaller than the marketing number.
record.reliability_note: Long-running, well-documented provider; the throttle is policy, not breakage. The TB-vs-TiB reporting gap is measured, not speculative.
